name: io.github.danieltomaro13/sportsdata-mcp
description: Live sports data and cross-book betting odds as ~500 MCP tools across 28 providers — 10+ bookmakers (Sportsbet, TAB, Betfair, Pinnacle, FanDuel), official league feeds (NBA, MLB, EPL, AFL, NRL, F1), racing, and Kalshi/Polymarket prediction markets. Free, zero-config.
